question: The area of the circular base of the tent house is 308 m², and its height is 7√2 m. Then find the area (in m²) of cloth required to cover the curved surface area of the conical tent.
solution:
**Given:**

The area of the circular base of the tent house is 308 m2, and its height is 7√2 m.

**Concept Used:**

The area of the circular base of the tent house = π × r²

The curved surface area of the conical tent = π × r × l

The slant height (L)² = { √{r²+h²}}

Where, r is radius & h is height.

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa41f208bb80bfcc5bcac65e6d7133921a02efddac77968efd26f852a3158345.png] **

According to question

π × r² = 308 m²

⇒ 22/7 × r² = 308 m²

⇒ r² = 308 × 7/22

⇒ r² = 98

⇒ r = 7√2 m

The slant height (L) = { √{r²+h²}}

⇒ L = { √{(7√2)²+(7√2)²}}

⇒ L= { √{98+98}}

⇒ L = 14 m 

The curved surface area of the conical tent = π × 7√2 × 14

⇒ 22/7 × 7√2 × 14 

⇒ 308√2 m

**∴ The curved surface area of the conical tent is 308√2 m²**
